text_blocks.snippet: The Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine has specific storage and handling requirements to maintain its integrity. It's shipped frozen and can be stored in an ultra-low temperature freezer (-90°C to -60°C). Once thawed, it can be stored in a refrigerator (2°C to 8°C) for up to 10 weeks, or at room temperature (8°C to 25°C) for up to 12 hours before the first puncture. Punctured vials must be discarded after 12 hours, regardless of temperature.
